Furthermore, the business possesses a proven long-term expansion engine, delivering a compounded sales growth rate of 16% over a five-year period [E13]. Conceded: [E3], [E7], [E14], [E16], [E21].

Growth metrics further invalidate the current share price, as 3-year compounded sales growth sits stagnant at 0% [E14] and TTM compounded profit growth has cratered by -61% [E16]. Conceded: the trailing twelve months P/E is -56.73x and the ROE is -16.65% [E5, E8], but the bear overlooks the sharp operational turnaround already underway, demonstrated by a quarterly operating margin improvement of 27 percentage points in June 2026 compared to the year-ago period [E22]. While the bear highlights a TTM operating margin contraction of 44 percentage points over three years [E21], it ignores the powerful top-line acceleration shown by 16% compounded sales growth over 5 years [E13] and recent screen reasons confirming 41% YoY sales growth [E55].
